# xsvr4

## Files

- disks.nix
- desktop.nix
- vms.nix
- default.nix
- network.nix
- minimal.nix

## File Summaries

### disks.nix
PLACEHOLDER — replace with xsvr4's actual boot NVMe by-id path once the hardware is installed (ls -la /dev/disk/by-id/ | grep nvme on xsvr4). Layout mirrors xsvr3.

### desktop.nix
Use XFCE instead of GNOME/LXQt to avoid heavy build dependencies

### vms.nix
PLACEHOLDER — replace with xsvr4's actual passthrough storage NVMe by-id path once the hardware is installed (ls -la /dev/disk/by-id/ | grep nvme on xsvr4).

### default.nix
NixOS host configuration for xsvr4, imports hardware, boot, desktop, and VM modules.

### network.nix
Termix (k8s pod on 172.20.3.0/24) was tripping fail2ban's maxretry=3 sshd jail while the routing issue to the main IP was being worked out.

### minimal.nix
Minimal installer configuration for xsvr4; deploy with deploy-rs after boot.

## Overview

This folder contains the following files with their respective purposes summarized above.
